caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular swatch of woven textile placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The textile is composed of a repeating grid pattern created by alternating bands of dark blue-black and beige. The overall design is a plaid made up of smaller squares and rectangles, each filled with different weaving patterns, including diagonal stripes, checkerboards, and small dot motifs. The lines dividing the squares are of varying thickness, forming a structured, geometric composition. At the lower right corner of the background, there is a small inscription that reads "Spitalfields." The edges of the textile and the paper show slight irregularities and faint marks, but the main focus is on the detailed, multicolored textile pattern.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
